title: The Glessner House is rebuilt the way the nightly build makes it
items: The Glessner House model now comes from the same build machine that checks it every night. The two versions of its shaded granite differed in a few thousand of its four million shading texels, and that small difference failed the nightly check for every Prairie Avenue change.
Nothing you can see has changed. The building's shape, stones and colours are byte for byte what they were.
